messages.author: Ven, Wouter van de
messages.body:
Dear all,
I am using AMBER24 and trying to run a 3-trajectory MM-GBSA analysis to determine the binding affinity of a ligand to the receptor.
However, when trying to run this it gives the following error: “AttributeError: 'MultiTrajBinding' object has no attribute 'delta2'”
It seems it is trying to run delta2() while this only exists for SingleTrajBinding. I don’t see why it passes running delta() exactly and can’t figure out how to avoid this error.
As far as I can see the topologies and trajectories match and provide no cause for errors.
Any suggestions or help is highly appreciated.
Wouter
